learning_outcomes.text: To teach an effective way to solve engineering problems by using computer programming language
After successfully completing the course, the student is able to decide whether an engineering problem should be solved manually or by programming
The student can analyze the problem with sufficient clarity to design an algorithm
Can test and debug the program. Writes the program with sufficient clarity and structure so that others can understand and use the program.
